values.note: $20 a night at every site in 2026 and 2027 (DNR rates table; booking site probed 2026-10-27 and 2027-05-20, 07-13 and Saturday 07-17). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Rifle River Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483520, maps 'Devoe', 'Spruce', 'Ranch', 'Grousehaven': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17) (Ranch campsites, fee schedule -32464: 20 on every probed date) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Rifle River / Rustic Campgrounds (Spruce, Ranch, & Devoe): Rustic camping rate $20) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/rifleriver ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Rifle River Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483520, maps 'Devoe', 'Spruce', 'Ranch', 'Grousehaven': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17) (25 Ranch campsites: 'Electrical Service=Not Available', 'Sewer Hookup=No') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/rifleriver (tags 'Rustic sites'; no electrical service listed), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 25 sites. Allowed trailer/RV length is 50 ft at 9 sites, 40 ft at 10, 30 ft at 4, 20 ft at one (site 140); site 139 is tents only. No pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/rifleriver ('Rifle River Ranch Rustic Campground': 'Number of sites: 25') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Rifle River Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483520, maps 'Devoe', 'Spruce', 'Ranch', 'Grousehaven': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17) (25 Ranch campsites; allowed equipment max 'Trailer or RV up to N'; no site 'Pull Through=Yes'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The park's sanitation station (two lanes, potable water) is near Grousehaven modern campground and is closed to non-registered campers.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/rifleriver ('Rifle River Ranch Rustic Campground' tags: 'Accessible vault toilet, Concession or store, Playground, Rustic sites, Sanitation station, State park campground, Vault toilet, Water access'; 'The park's sanitation station is located near the modern campground. There is potable water available and two lanes.' 'This location is unable to offer sanitation station access to non-registered campers'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/rifleriver ('Rifle River Ranch Rustic Campground': 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Rifle River / Rustic Campgrounds (Spruce, Ranch, & Devoe): reservation season starts 'April 15', ends 'November 29') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Rifle River Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483520, maps 'Devoe', 'Spruce', 'Ranch', 'Grousehaven': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic campground in Rifle River Recreation Area near Lupton, with grassy sites along the Rifle River and a playground. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + rates table + MiDNRReservations: $20 for 2026 and 2027 (confirmed), 25 sites (confirmed), no electric (confirmed) and no sewer, vault toilets (confirmed); added max 50 ft (most 40-50 ft), no pull-throughs, the park sanitation station, reservable on MiDNRReservations / 800-447-2757, reservation season April 15 - November 29 (confirmed, derived -> manual). No campground season statement. Phone matches. Pin is on OSM's 'Rifle River-Ranch Rustic Campground'. Note trimmed of field restatements.
